int_name: N OPAL ST & W SOMERSET ST

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with sidewalks on both sides, though one side is significantly obstructed by a parked vehicle. The environment lacks formal pedestrian infrastructure like marked crosswalks or signals, and the narrow roadway width suggests a low-speed but informal traffic environment.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Parking
hazards.description: A vehicle is parked entirely on the sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to walk in the active roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street, mid-ground

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and overgrown vegetation along the fence line limit sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the roadway

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven pavement on both the sidewalk and roadway creates potential trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway and left sidewalk

interventions.title: Sidewalk Protection
interventions.description: Install bollards or high curbs to prevent vehicles from parking on and obstructing the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near potential crossing points to improve visibility between motorists and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the sidewalk to provide a smooth, accessible path for all users, including those with mobility aids.

result.summary: The image shows a residential/mixed-use urban intersection that lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and traffic control devices. While the street is relatively narrow, the absence of designated crossing areas and the presence of parked vehicles near the corner create significant visibility and accessibility challenges.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate where pedestrians should cross or to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection area

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps
hazards.description: The lack of sloped curb transitions makes the crossing inaccessible for wheelchair users and creates a trip hazard for others.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk in the foreground

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners may block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the right side of the street

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at all corners of the intersection to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: This residential intersection features continuous sidewalks but lacks basic pedestrian crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or curb ramps. The narrow street geometry likely encourages lower vehicle speeds, but the absence of traffic control or accessibility features creates a barrier for vulnerable road users.

hazards.name: Lack of ADA Accessibility
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps at the intersection corners prevents safe and easy access for pedestrians with mobility aids, strollers, or carts.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners of the intersection in the foreground.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks to designate pedestrian right-of-way or alert drivers to potential crossing activity.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the intersection of the two streets.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Intersection
hazards.description: No stop signs or traffic signals are visible to manage vehicle right-of-way at the junction.
hazards.location_in_image: The center of the street intersection.

interventions.title: Install ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Construct sloped curb transitions with detectable warning surfaces at all four corners of the intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Paint continental or ladder-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the corners to ensure clear sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching motorists.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with row houses and sidewalks on both sides. The pedestrian environment is degraded by poor sidewalk conditions, including significant cracking and a signpost obstructing the walkway, as well as a complete lack of marked crossing infrastructure.

hazards.name: Uneven Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the right side is heavily cracked and uneven, creating a significant trip hazard for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground sidewalk

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A signpost is placed in the middle of the sidewalk, reducing the effective width for pedestrians and those with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-right sidewalk

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs visible, forcing pedestrians to cross in an unprotected environment.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway throughout

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and repave the cracked sidewalk to provide a smooth, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
